meta.title: Ultra-Luxury Chalet in Méribel, 3 Valleys — Chalet Yolo
meta.description: 330 m² over four levels with a lift: six bedrooms including four suites, heated indoor pool, spa, home cinema and yoga room in Méribel, Les 3 Vallées.

intro.title: The chalet
intro.text:
Chalet Yolo is an exceptional retreat near Le Raffort, in Méribel, at the heart of the 3 Valleys. This contemporary chalet sleeps up to 15 guests across six bedrooms, with an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, hammam, yoga room and home cinema.
Your stay is fully taken care of by a chef, a chalet manager and a chauffeur.

pool.title: Pool & Jacuzzi
pool.text: Heated and entirely private, the indoor pool welcomes morning lengths and evening unwinding alike, after a day on the 600 km of slopes of Les 3 Vallées.

wellness.title: Spa & Wellness
wellness.text: Sauna, hammam, Jacuzzi and Jacuzzi bath: a complete spa, all to yourselves. The perfect setting for an in-chalet massage, bookable à la carte.

cinema.title: Home Cinema
cinema.text: A cinema room for the latest release, a mountain classic or the memories of the day.

yoga.title: Yoga & Fitness Room
yoga.text: Stretch before the first lift of the morning, release the tension after the last run: a room dedicated to yoga, in peace and quiet, without leaving the chalet.

living.title: Lounges & Kitchen
living.text: On the 4th level, the cathedral-ceiling living room brings together a fireplace, a large dining table and a fitted kitchen. The chef's playground, and the heart of the chalet.

rooms.title: Bedrooms & Suites
rooms.text: Six bedrooms, including four suites, for up to 15 guests.

location.title: Location
location.text: The chalet is located near Le Raffort, in Méribel. The Chalet is 4 min away from city-center and 5 min away from the slopes.
